name: Challenge Love
source:
Welcome back to Havenwood!
This is an incredibly open campus where beautiful women circulate newspapers and work part-time at cafes!

Start studying love with the women you meet here!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668810/]Steam[/url]]

欢迎回到黑文伍德！
这是一个令人难以置信的开放校园，美女们在咖啡馆里分发报纸和兼职！

开始与你在这里遇到的女性一起研究爱情！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668810/]Steam[/url]]
